record.question: Anaemia is caused by the deficiency of which mineral?
record.explanation: Answer D: Iron. Iron deficiency is a common cause of iron-deficiency anemia; among the listed minerals, iron is the intended deficiency. Reference: https://medlineplus.gov/ency/article/000584.htm. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
